stories.title: Fed's Collins Backs Gradual Rate Hikes to Manage Risks
stories.summary: A Federal Reserve official named Collins said gradual interest rate hikes are the best way to manage economic risks. The remark came without a specific timeline or target rate. It adds one more data point to the ongoing debate over the Fed's next moves.
stories.whyItMatters: Fed officials' comments shape rate expectations, which move bond yields and stock valuations.
whatToWatch: Further Fed speeches for more detail on rate plans
questions: What specific risks is Collins referring to?
Do other Fed officials share this gradual approach?

stories.title: Thousands of US Flights Canceled or Delayed as Air System Recovers From Shutdown

stories.whyItMatters: Travel disruptions hit airline stocks and can signal broader strain in consumer spending.
